Location: Dunbar and 31st ave, safe and vibrant community

- Steps away from bus stop with multiple transit options to UBC
- Steps away from coffee shop, grocery, restaurants, library, community centre, tennis courts and more
- Bus 7 takes you directly to Downtown

Property:

Located on a quiet tree-lined street, our home is always lived and loved by UBC students. Current tenant lived here since year 2 and is moving due to graduation.

Key Features

Size: 700 sqft
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 1
Lease Duration: 1 Year
Pet policy: no pet
Parking: Street
Occupancy: May 1 2026
Furniture: Not included

Main level features living/dining area, gourmet kitchen with high end appliances and cabinets. Second floor features 2 bedroom(spacious) , one bathroom, and abundant natural light.

2mins walking to tennis court, bus stop, community centre; 5 mins walking to library, Coffee, restaurants, supermarkets, parks. Appliances include Oven, Stovetop, Dishwasher, Fridge, Washer and Dryer.

Excellent School Catchment: Lord Kitchener & LordByng

bike 18mins to UBC. BUS 13mins to UBC.
